title: federation_onboarding_running_image_identity_survives_rename_replacement can fail with Disconnected: the image child exits before printing IMAGE_HASH
outcome: tests::federation_onboarding_image::federation_onboarding_running_image_identity_survives_rename_replacement passes deterministically on Windows in the full gate. If the image child process exits early, the test reports the child's exit status and stderr rather than a bare recv Disconnected, so a recurrence is diagnosable from the gate log.
acceptance: The root cause of the Disconnected failure in gate test-c2742aa3 is classified as product, test/runner or environment, with discriminating evidence recorded on this item.
The fixture surfaces the child's exit status and captured stderr when the child stops before its expected line, instead of unwrapping recv_timeout's Disconnected.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact committed tree with an independent review pair and no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
